name: Article 4, § 5/1
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: ‘Member States shall ensure that the results and data of other relevant environmental assessments under Union or national legislation are made available to developers for their preparation of the environmental reports referred to in Article 5 of Directive 2011/92/EU within reasonable timelines, respecting the limitations with regard to commercial and industrial confidentiality, including intellectual property, data protection and the safeguarding of the public interest.’
